title: Fewer false payment errors for ElevenMusic
summary:
Ten community apps joined the catalog, while fixes addressed false ElevenMusic 402s, image-edit seeds, and stale account names.

ElevenMusic MP3 responses now use a duration estimate suited to MP3 rather than MP4 header parsing. Balance pre-checks also cap anomalous usage estimates, addressing cases where a request could incorrectly receive a 402.

Image requests to Vertex AI now pass along a provided seed. Changing the seed for Nano Banana image edits can therefore reach the model instead of being lost before regeneration.

The community catalog added a Claude Code plugin for generating text and media, a short-form video editor, three image-generation apps, and a writing app. Pollinations AI All-in-One Generation also brings images, music, and text together in one app.
